title: 第十六章 失窃的星图碎片第十五章 古籍库星图残影
lines: 第十六章：失窃的星图碎片
夜幕像一块浸透了墨汁的绒布，缓缓覆盖住幻境学院的尖顶塔楼。图书馆顶层的古籍库却还亮着微光，空气中漂浮着陈旧纸张与魔法墨水混合的特殊气味，书架上一排排烫金封皮的典籍在月光下泛着冷寂的光泽。
林澈蜷缩在靠窗的角落，指尖无意识地划过一本摊开的《空间魔法基础理论》。书页上的符文像是活的，在他视线扫过时微微发亮——这是他觉醒“空间感知”天赋后才有的怪事，仿佛世间所有与空间相关的事物，都会主动向他传递某种信息。
“还在看？再过半小时古籍库就要闭馆了。”
苏璃的声音带着草木般的清新，打断了林澈的走神。她怀里抱着一摞关于植物契约的卷轴，绿色的魔法微光在她发梢跳跃。今天下午的实战课上，她操控着藤蔓缠住了失控的土元素，那精准的控制力让林澈印象深刻。
“在想早上导师说的星图。”林澈合上书，指尖残留着书页上淡淡的能量波动，“你说，那东西真的藏在古籍库里？”
“谁知道呢。”苏璃挨着他坐下，窗外传来钟楼敲响的八下钟声，“不过学院里关于秘境的传说，十有八九都和古籍库有关。我父亲说，这里的藏书比灵都国的皇家图书馆还多，有些甚至是上古传下来的孤本。”
她话音刚落，古籍库深处突然传来“咔哒”一声轻响，像是有什么东西撞到了书架。
林澈的瞳孔骤然收缩。他的空间感知比常人敏锐百倍，此刻能清晰地捕捉到一股不属于这里的能量——阴冷、粘稠，像潜伏在暗处的蛇，正沿着书架之间的缝隙缓慢移动。
“有人。”他压低声音，伸手按住苏璃的肩膀，示意她别动。
两人屏住呼吸，借着书架投下的阴影隐蔽身形。那股阴冷的能量在古籍库中央停下，紧接着，一阵细碎的翻书声响起，夹杂着布料摩擦木头的窸窣声。
林澈悄悄探出头，视线穿过层层书架的缝隙，落在古籍库最内侧的区域。那里立着一座半人高的青铜书架，书架前站着一个裹着黑色斗篷的身影，兜帽压得很低，只能看到一截苍白的下颌。
那人正用戴着黑色手套的手，快速翻阅着书架顶层的一本厚重典籍。典籍的封皮是深棕色的，边角已经磨损，封面上用金色墨水绘制的星图图案在昏暗的光线下若隐若现——正是导师在课上提过的《幻灵星轨考》，传说中记载着秘境坐标星图的孤本。
“是冲着星图来的。”苏璃的声音带着一丝紧张，她指尖微动，几缕绿色的藤蔓悄无声息地从袖口滑出，缠绕在旁边的书架腿上，随时准备发动攻击。
林澈却按住了她的手。他能感觉到，那黑衣人身上的能量波动很不稳定，像是在刻意压制着什么，而且……对方的动作虽然迅速，却带着一种生涩感，不像是经验丰富的盗书贼，更像是在急切地寻找某个特定的东西。
就在这时，黑衣人似乎找到了目标。他从《幻灵星轨考》中抽出了一张泛黄的羊皮纸，展开的瞬间，羊皮纸上绘制的星图突然爆发出银色的光芒，无数细碎的星点沿着图上的线条流转，像把一片浓缩的星空捧在了手里。
“找到了……”黑衣人发出一声压抑的低叹，声音里带着难以掩饰的激动，还有一丝不易察觉的颤抖。
但他的手指刚触碰到星图的中心，羊皮纸突然剧烈地闪烁起来，银色光芒瞬间变成刺目的金色，一道纤细的光带从星图上射出，像鞭子一样抽向黑衣人的手背。
“嘶——”黑衣人痛呼一声，猛地松开手。羊皮纸从他掌心滑落，在空中撕裂成数道碎片，其中最大的一块带着耀眼的金光，直直地朝着林澈藏身的方向飞来。
林澈下意识地伸手去接，指尖触碰到碎片的刹那，一股庞大的信息流突然涌入他的脑海——旋转的星云、破碎的大陆轮廓、还有无数闪烁着不同颜色的光点，像是在标注着某个巨大空间的坐标。
与此同时，黑衣人转身就跑，黑色的斗篷在书架间划出一道残影，眼看就要冲出古籍库的大门。
“别让他跑了！”苏璃低喝一声，缠绕在书架上的藤蔓骤然暴长，像绿色的绳索般朝着黑衣人脚下缠去。
但黑衣人似乎早有准备，他反手一挥，一股带着硫磺味的黑色火焰突然燃起，瞬间将藤蔓烧成了灰烬。火焰的光芒照亮了他兜帽下的半张脸——那是一张年轻的面容，左额角有一道暗红色的疤痕，眼神里却带着与年龄不符的阴鸷。
“是暗影教派的标记！”苏璃惊呼出声。她在灵都国的典籍里见过这种火焰，那是被列为禁忌的“蚀骨火”，只有暗影教派的人才会使用。
黑衣人没有恋战，借着火焰阻拦的瞬间，他撞开古籍库的木门，身影迅速消失在走廊的阴影里。
林澈立刻追了出去，却只在走廊尽头看到一扇被撞开的窗户，夜风吹动着窗帘，窗外的石板路上残留着几滴黑色的液体，散发着淡淡的腥气。
“他跑了。”苏璃跟上来，看着窗外空荡荡的庭院，眉头紧锁，“而且星图碎了，我们只拿到一块碎片。”
林澈低头看向掌心的羊皮纸碎片。碎片只有巴掌大小，上面的星图残缺不全，只能看到几颗明亮的星点和一段扭曲的线条，但那股熟悉的空间波动却异常清晰，像是在召唤着什么。
“这碎片不简单。”他指尖轻轻摩挲着碎片边缘，“我能感觉到，它和学院里某个地方产生了共鸣。”
就在这时，古籍库外传来了急促的脚步声，伴随着导师艾瑞克低沉的声音：“发生什么事了？我感应到这里有异常的能量波动。”
艾瑞克推开门，看到散落一地的书页和林澈手中的羊皮纸碎片，脸色瞬间沉了下来。这位总是笑眯眯的老法师此刻眼神锐利如鹰，扫过林澈和苏璃，最后落在那扇敞开的窗户上。
“暗影教派的人来过了？”他快步走到书架前，看着那本被翻开的《幻灵星轨考》，语气凝重，“他们偷走了星图？”
“星图碎了，”林澈将手中的碎片递过去，“他只拿到了其中几块，我们这里有一块。”
艾瑞克接过碎片，指尖覆盖上一层淡蓝色的魔法微光。当他的魔法触碰到碎片时，碎片突然剧烈地颤抖起来，上面的星点发出耀眼的光芒，在空气中投射出一道模糊的影像——那是一片被浓雾笼罩的森林，森林中央矗立着一座残破的石碑，石碑上刻着与星图相似的纹路。
“是迷雾森林。”艾瑞克的声音带着一丝震惊，“第一处秘境的入口，竟然藏在那里。”
影像只持续了几秒钟就消失了，碎片重新恢复平静。艾瑞克将碎片小心翼翼地收好，看向林澈和苏璃，眼神复杂：“你们两个，跟我来一趟办公室。这件事，恐怕比我们想象的还要复杂。”
林澈和苏璃对视一眼，都从对方眼中看到了凝重。暗影教派的突然出现，破碎的星图，还有那片神秘的迷雾森林……这一切都像是一张无形的网，正在悄然收紧。
而他们还不知道，这场围绕着秘境的争夺，才刚刚开始。
夜色渐深，学院的钟楼再次敲响，悠长的钟声在寂静的校园里回荡，带着一种莫名的不安。古籍库的灯光被熄灭，只剩下窗外的月光，冷冷地洒在那排空荡荡的书架上，仿佛在无声地诉说着刚刚发生的一切。
而在学院某处隐蔽的角落里，那个黑衣人正靠在墙壁上，剧烈地喘息着。他摘下兜帽，露出一张年轻而苍白的脸，左额角的疤痕在月光下泛着诡异的红光。他摊开手掌，掌心里躺着三块残缺的星图碎片，碎片边缘还残留着灼烧的痕迹。
“只差一点……”他低声呢喃，声音里充满了不甘，“只要拿到完整的星图，就能找到秘境，就能……”
他突然剧烈地咳嗽起来，咳出的痰液带着暗红色的血丝。他捂住嘴，眼神却变得更加狂热：“父亲，母亲，等着我，我一定会找到秘境里的‘时光之泉’，治好你们的诅咒……”
说完，他将碎片收好，再次裹紧斗篷，身影一闪，消失在学院的阴影深处，只留下一串逐渐被夜风抹去的脚印。
一场关于星图与秘境的追逐，已在无人知晓的暗夜里，悄然拉开了序幕。

Chapter 16: Stolen Star Map Fragments
The night was like a piece of velvet soaked in ink, slowly covering the steeple tower of Illusion Academy. The ancient books on the top floor of the library were still dimly lit, and the special smell of old paper and magic ink floated in the air. The rows of gold-covered books on the bookshelves glowed with a cold luster in the moonlight.
Lin Che huddled in the corner by the window, her fingertips unconsciously running across an open book called "Basic Theory of Space Magic." The runes on the page seemed alive, glowing slightly as he glanced across them - this was a strange thing that happened after he awakened his "space perception" talent. It seemed that everything related to space in the world would actively transmit some kind of information to him.
"Still reading? The ancient book library will be closed in half an hour."
Su Li's voice was as fresh as grass, interrupting Lin Che's distraction. She held a stack of scrolls about plant contracts in her arms, and a green magical light danced in her hair. In the practical class this afternoon, she controlled the vines to entangle the out-of-control earth element. Lin Che was deeply impressed by her precise control.
"I was thinking about the star map my instructor talked about this morning." Lin Che closed the book, and the faint energy fluctuations on the pages remained on her fingertips. "Do you think that thing is really hidden in the ancient book library?"
"Who knows." Su Li sat down next to him, and the eight bells ringing from the bell tower were heard outside the window. "But the legends about the secret realm in the academy are most likely related to the ancient book library. My father said that the collection of books here is more than the Royal Library of Lingdu Kingdom, and some are even unique books handed down from ancient times."
As soon as she finished speaking, a soft "click" sound suddenly came from deep in the ancient book library, as if something hit the bookshelf.
Lin Che's pupils suddenly shrank. His spatial perception was a hundred times sharper than that of ordinary people. At this moment, he could clearly capture an energy that did not belong here - cold and sticky, like a snake lurking in the dark, moving slowly along the gaps between the bookshelves.
"There is someone." He lowered his voice and reached out to hold Su Li's shoulders, signaling her not to move.
The two of them held their breath and used the shadows cast by the bookshelf to hide their figures. The cold energy stopped in the center of the ancient books library, and then there was a faint sound of turning books, mixed with the rustling sound of cloth rubbing against wood.
Lin Che quietly poked her head out, her gaze passed through the gaps in the bookshelves and landed on the innermost area of ​​the ancient books library. There stood a bronze bookshelf half as tall as a man. In front of the bookshelf stood a figure wrapped in a black cloak. The hood was so low that only a section of his pale lower jaw could be seen.
The man was using his black-gloved hands to quickly flip through a thick classic on the top shelf. The cover of the classic book is dark brown and has worn edges. The star map pattern drawn with golden ink on the cover is faintly visible in the dim light - it is the "Phantom Star Track Test" mentioned by the instructor in class. It is said to be the only copy of the star map that records the coordinates of the secret realm.
"It's for the star map." Su Li's voice was a little nervous. She moved her fingertips slightly, and a few strands of green vines slipped out of the cuffs silently and wrapped around the legs of the bookshelf next to them, ready to attack at any time.
Lin Che held her hand down. He could feel that the energy fluctuations on the man in black were very unstable, as if he was deliberately suppressing something, and... although the other party's movements were fast, they had a sense of jerkiness, not like an experienced book thief, but more like he was eagerly looking for something specific.
At this moment, the man in black seemed to have found his target. He pulled out a piece of yellowed parchment from "Phantom Star Track Test". The moment he unfolded it, the star map drawn on the parchment suddenly burst out with silver light, and countless tiny star points flowed along the lines on the map, as if he was holding a condensed starry sky in his hand.
"Found it..." The man in black let out a suppressed sigh, with unconcealable excitement in his voice and a hint of unnoticeable trembling.
But as soon as his fingers touched the center of the star map, the parchment suddenly flickered violently, and the silver light instantly turned into dazzling gold. A thin strip of light shot out from the star map, hitting the back of the man in black's hand like a whip.
"Hiss—" The man in black screamed in pain and suddenly let go of his hand. The parchment slipped from his palm and was torn into several pieces in the air. The largest piece of it flew straight towards Lin Che's hiding place with a dazzling golden light.
Lin Che subconsciously reached out to pick it up. The moment her fingertips touched the fragment, a huge flow of information suddenly poured into his mind - rotating nebulae, broken continent outlines, and countless light spots flashing in different colors, as if marking the coordinates of a huge space.
At the same time, the man in black turned around and ran away, his black cloak creating an afterimage between the bookshelves, and he was about to rush out of the ancient book library door.
"Don't let him run away!" Su Li shouted, and the vines wrapped around the bookshelf suddenly grew and wrapped around the feet of the man in black like a green rope.
But the man in black seemed to have been prepared. With a wave of his backhand, a black flame with the smell of sulfur suddenly ignited, instantly burning the vines to ashes. The light of the flames illuminated half of his face under the hood - it was a young face, with a dark red scar on the left corner of his forehead, but there was a sinister look in his eyes that was inconsistent with his age.
"It's the mark of the Shadow Sect!" Su Li exclaimed. She had seen this kind of flame in the books of Lingdu Kingdom. It was a taboo "bone-eroding fire" that could only be used by members of the Shadow Sect.
The man in black didn't want to fight. With the flame blocking the moment, he knocked open the wooden door of the ancient book library, and his figure quickly disappeared into the shadow of the corridor.
Lin Che immediately chased after him, but only saw a window that had been knocked open at the end of the corridor. The night wind blew the curtains, and there were a few drops of black liquid remaining on the stone pavement outside the window, exuding a faint fishy smell.
"He ran away." Su Li followed, looking at the empty courtyard outside the window, frowning, "And the star map was broken, and we only got one fragment."
Lin Che lowered her head and looked at the pieces of parchment in her palm. The fragment was only the size of a palm, and the star map on it was incomplete. Only a few bright star points and a twisted line could be seen, but the familiar space fluctuations were extremely clear, as if they were summoning something.
"This fragment is not simple." He gently stroked the edge of the fragment with his fingertips, "I can feel that it resonates with somewhere in the academy."
At this moment, rapid footsteps came from outside the ancient book library, accompanied by the deep voice of mentor Eric: "What happened? I sensed abnormal energy fluctuations here."
Eric opened the door and saw the pages of books scattered on the floor and the pieces of parchment in Lin Che's hand, and his face instantly darkened. The old mage who was always smiling was now as sharp as an eagle, scanning Lin Che and Su Li, and finally landed on the open window.
"Have the people from the Shadow Sect come here?" He walked quickly to the bookshelf, looked at the opened "Phantom Star Orbit Test", and said in a solemn tone, "Did they steal the star map?"
"The star map is broken," Lin Che handed over the fragments in her hand, "He only got a few pieces of it, and we have one here."
Eric took the fragment and his fingertips were covered with a layer of light blue magic light. When his magic touched the fragment, it suddenly trembled violently, and the stars on it emitted a dazzling light, projecting a blurry image in the air - it was a forest shrouded in thick fog, and in the center of the forest stood a broken stone tablet, with lines similar to the star map carved on it.
"It's the misty forest." Eric's voice was filled with shock. "The entrance to the first secret realm is actually hidden there."
The image lasted only a few seconds before disappearing, and the fragments returned to calm. Eric put away the fragments carefully and looked at Lin Che and Su Li with complicated eyes: "You two, come to the office with me. This matter may be more complicated than we imagined."
Lin Che and Su Li looked at each other and saw solemnity in each other's eyes. The sudden appearance of the Shadow Sect, the broken star map, and the mysterious misty forest... all of this is like an invisible net that is quietly tightening.
But they still don’t know that this battle over the secret realm has just begun.
As the night grew darker, the bell tower of the college rang again, and the long bell echoed in the silent campus, bringing with it an inexplicable uneasiness. The lights in the ancient book library were extinguished, leaving only the moonlight outside the window, which shone coldly on the row of empty bookshelves, as if silently telling what had just happened.
And somewhere in a hidden corner of the academy, the man in black was leaning against the wall, breathing heavily. He took off his hood, revealing a young and pale face, and the scar on his left forehead glowed strangely red in the moonlight. He opened his palms, and there were three incomplete star map fragments lying in his palms, with burn marks still remaining on the edges of the fragments.
"It's just a little bit..." He murmured in a low voice, his voice full of unwillingness, "As long as we get the complete star map, we can find the secret realm, and we can..."
He suddenly coughed violently, and the phlegm he coughed up was dark red with blood streaks. He covered his mouth, but his eyes became more fanatical: "Father, mother, wait for me, I will definitely find the 'Fountain of Time' in the secret realm and cure your curse..."
After saying that, he put away the fragments and wrapped his cloak tightly again. His figure flashed and disappeared into the shadows of the academy, leaving only a series of footprints that were gradually erased by the night wind.
A chase about the star map and the secret realm has quietly begun in the dark night where no one knows.
